headline.zh: 为推理工作负载选择定制MPU方案
headline.en: Choose Custom MPU for Inference Workload

scenario.zh: 你的公司需要在边缘设备上运行视觉检测模型，评估Lamb Labs的硬编码权重芯片方案能否满足延迟和功耗需求
scenario.en: Your company needs to run vision detection models on edge devices and evaluate if Lamb Labs' weight-hardcoded chip meets latency and power needs

instruction.zh: 选择需要在边缘设备部署的AI模型类型
instruction.en: Choose the AI model type for edge deployment

output.zh: 选定3.2M参数模型，适合硬编码到定制芯片，推理延迟需求15ms以内
output.en: Selected 3.2M parameter model, suitable for chip hardcoding with sub-15ms latency requirement

output.zh: 选定27M参数模型，权重硬编码需更大芯片面积，延迟需求40ms以内
output.en: Selected 27M parameter model, requires larger chip area for weight hardcoding, sub-40ms latency need

instruction.zh: 根据边缘设备电源条件设定芯片功耗上限
instruction.en: Set chip power ceiling based on edge device power conditions

output.zh: MPU配置为超低功耗模式，消除内存访问后功耗降至传统GPU方案的十分之一左右
output.en: MPU configured for ultra-low power, eliminating memory access reduces consumption to roughly one-tenth of traditional GPU

output.zh: MPU配置为平衡模式，功耗宽裕可提升时钟频率，延迟表现优于低功耗模式
output.en: MPU configured for balanced mode, ample power allows higher clock for better latency than low-power mode

instruction.zh: 对比Lamb Labs MPU与传统推理芯片的关键指标
instruction.en: Compare Lamb Labs MPU with traditional inference chips on key metrics

output.zh: 无内存带宽瓶颈，单次推理能耗大幅降低，但模型固定无法更新
output.en: No memory bandwidth bottleneck, drastically lower energy per inference, but model fixed and non-updatable

label.zh: 通用推理加速器（外部权重）

output.zh: 模型可灵活更新，但每次推理需从内存加载权重，功耗和延迟均明显更高
output.en: Model flexibly updatable, but each inference loads weights from memory with noticeably higher power and latency

instruction.zh: 确认定制MPU是否适合你的边缘推理场景
instruction.en: Confirm if custom MPU suits your edge inference scenario

output.zh: 模型稳定且能效优先场景下，硬编码权重方案显著降低推理能耗并消除带宽瓶颈
output.en: For stable models prioritizing efficiency, hardcoded weights drastically cut inference energy and eliminate bandwidth bottleneck

output.zh: 模型需频繁更新或A/B测试场景下，可编程加速器提供更高灵活性尽管能效较低
output.en: For frequent model updates or A/B testing, programmable accelerators offer greater flexibility despite lower efficiency

takeaway.zh: Lamb Labs将模型权重直接硬编码到芯片消除内存瓶颈，适合模型稳定的边缘推理场景实现超高能效
takeaway.en: Lamb Labs hardcodes model weights into silicon to eliminate memory bottleneck, ideal for stable-model edge inference with ultra-high efficiency
